Simulated child anthropometry (DHS-style)

Source: R/data.R
child_anthro.Rd

Children under five living in the households of ncd_survey, with height-for-age, weight-for-age and weight-for-height z-scores stored in the DHS recode convention: multiplied by 100, with flag codes 9996 (height out of plausible range) and 9998 (missing), and a few biologically implausible values. The data are entirely synthetic.

Usage

child_anthro

Format

A data frame with 1,034 rows and 14 variables:

child_id

Child identifier.

hh_id

Household identifier (links to ncd_survey).

region, residence, stratum, psu, wt

Design variables, inherited from the household.

sex

"Female" or "Male".

age_months

Age in months (0-59).

wealth_score, wealth_quintile

Household wealth, as in ncd_survey.

hw70

Height-for-age z-score x 100 (DHS variable name).

hw71

Weight-for-age z-score x 100.

hw72

Weight-for-height z-score x 100.

Source

Simulated; see data-raw/simulate_survey.R in https://github.com/StatAid-Research-Lab/SurveyNCD.

Examples

table(who_anthro_score(child_anthro$hw70, indicator = "stunting"),
      useNA = "ifany")
#> 
#>   Severe stunting Moderate stunting   Normal stunting              <NA> 
#>                81               209               725                19
